properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated July 14, [1949], on stationery from the Manila Hotel; includes brief description of Tokyo hotel deal; meals with Alli [Ernest Allison], Bondy [William L. Bond], Ki Chun, Harvey Hancock, P.Y. Wong, C.Y. Liu, Kenneth Chun, Jimmie Sampson; mentions J.T.T. [Juan Trippe], President [Elpido] Quirino, General Douglas A. MacArthur and Mr. Pride, the Pan American Airways lawyer in Tokyo.
